international_aviation.headline: 美國FAA核發波音737-7修正型別證 清除商業營運障礙
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局已授予波音737-7飛機修正型別證，為該機型投入商業服務清除障礙。波音與啟動客戶西南航空正準備交付首架飛機。FAA同時更新波音第700號生產證書以納入737-7。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. FAA Grants Boeing Amended Type Certificate for 737-7, Clearing It for Commercial Service
international_aviation.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has granted Boeing an amended type certificate for the 737-7 airplane, clearing it for commercial service. Boeing and launch customer Southwest Airlines are preparing for delivery of the first airplane. The FAA also updated Boeing Production Certificate No. 700 to include the 737-7.

new_information: The U.S. FAA has granted Boeing an amended type certificate for the 737-7 airplane, clearing it for commercial service.
Boeing and Southwest Airlines, the 737-7 launch customer, are preparing for delivery of the first airplane.
The 737-7 seats 135-160 passengers in a two-class configuration and offers a range of up to 3,800 nautical miles (7,040 km).

The certification test program began in 2018 and included more than 1,000 hours of flight and ground testing, extensive system safety analysis and human factors reviews, and an updated engine anti-ice system.
The FAA also updated Boeing Production Certificate No. 700 (PC 700) to include the 737-7.
As of July, Boeing anticipated certification of the 737-7 in 2026 and first delivery in 2027.

international_aviation.headline: 波音787-10搭GEnx發動機 廣體客機油耗評比奪冠
international_aviation.summary: 根據《Aircraft Commerce》針對14種廣體客機與發動機組合進行的燃油消耗評比，搭載GEnx發動機的波音787-10夢幻客機在評比中高居首位，在燃油表現上擊敗了其餘13種廣體客機與發動機搭配組合。
international_aviation.headline_en: GEnx-Powered Boeing 787-10 Ranks First in Widebody Fuel Burn Study
international_aviation.summary_en: A comparative fuel burn study conducted by Aircraft Commerce evaluated 14 widebody engine-airframe combinations across the commercial airline sector. According to ranking details reported by aviation news outlet Simple Flying on August 3, 2026, the Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner aircraft powered by GEnx engines achieved the top position overall. The GEnx-powered Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner came first in fuel burn efficiency, outperforming 13 other widebody engine and airframe combinations assessed in the study.
